MOT-22 first shipped this row as set-only on the argument that a clear would be a synonym for set 0; the eleven other in-scope basic-Integer enum fields refute it. Every one of them carries the derived set|clear and every one of their zero members is a substantive value (CmPicture.LayoutPos=CenterInColumn, LexEntryRef.RefType=Variant, PhSegmentRule.Direction=LeftToRightIterative), so clear in this manifest has never meant 'erase to nothing'; it means 'write the zero member'. SpellingStatus is the one enum of the twelve whose zero genuinely means no judgement recorded, which makes it the best candidate for clear rather than the worst. | EnumValues source: MasterLCModel.xml:3965-3969 (comment: undecided, correct, incorrect; min=0 max=2). | HcReachable=no: engine/UI state driving the concordance-view display, never read by HCLoader.
